mapper.select: SELECT e.*, a.area_id, a.area_name, a.area_price, a.qty FROM events e LEFT JOIN area a ON e.events_id = a.events_id
SELECT e.*, a.area_id, a.area_name, a.area_price, a.qty FROM events e LEFT JOIN area a ON e.events_id = a.events_id WHERE e.events_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{input}, '%')
SELECT e.*, a.area_id, a.area_name, a.area_price, a.qty FROM events e LEFT JOIN area a ON e.events_id = a.events_id WHERE e.events_id = #{eventsId}
SELECT e.*, a.area_id, a.area_name, a.area_price, a.qty FROM events e LEFT JOIN area a ON e.events_id = a.events_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.events_id, a.area_id
